x.description: input array. Complex values are not supported.
constraints: Returned array has the same shape as x.

output.description: A boolean array of the same shape as ``x``, containing ``True`` where the sign of ``x`` is negative, and ``False`` otherwise.

constraints: For floating point values, returns the value of the actual sign bit.
Special values such as signed NaN return the sign bit accordingly.
`signbit` on boolean values treats `True` as negative and `False` as positive.
